lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Partner...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Has my voice found its way to you?
Yes.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I knew it.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: You are the only partner with whom I have made a covenant with the soul.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: But even that won't last.
What's the matter?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Though it pains me to admit it, but...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: For I, Guillotine De Mephisto,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: consumption is approaching.
Does "consumption" refer to the eclipse?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Precisely, Partner.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Soon, when the moon begins to bleed crimson,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: my magical power will rapidly deplete,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: in order to suppress the raging power of the One-Winged Dark Lord.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Gradually, my strength will wane.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: The area below my spine will begin to tremble,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: and I will emanate strange sounds.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: This curse is most powerful, and my fate is most tragic.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: They are incomparable in their sheer magnitude.
What do you want to eat the most?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Are you listening to me?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: To eat at such a critical moment

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: would be tantamount to

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: giving it to my demonic other half.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: That is why

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I practice my ascetic lifestyle.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Even if it means sacrificing myself, it's for the good of the world.
Are you in the mood for some steak?
Are you in the mood for something sweet?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Meat!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Argh... Do you hear that?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: The screams... of the sacrifices...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: the simmering pulse of impending doom!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Dessert!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Using sugary goodness to tempt me, are you?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: You are trying to make me a pawn of the One-Winged Dark Lord?!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Do not seduce me so, Partner.
Okay, I'll bring you some.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Very well, you leave me with no choice.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: This is the burden which I must bear!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Do it then. Bring it to me,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: and grant me this catharsis!
